transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Nice to meet you too. Um, I came in today because... well, I've been having some trouble with my communication lately. People keep telling me they can’t follow what I’m trying to explain. 

It's happening with my artist statements, my notes for clients, and even just what I say in meetings. I guess my words are jumping around a lot. Like, I'll go from talking about the textures of a piece, right into budgets, and then into... I don't know, secret meanings behind things. It makes sense in my head, but apparently, it's getting really hard for anyone else to understand me.
Have you been feeling unusually high, euphoric, or full of energy lately?

Yeah, I have. Um, for stretches of time, I just feel... lit up, I guess. Almost unstoppable. It's like every idea I have for a project is completely brilliant and I have all this energy to just go, go, go. But then, on the flip side... if a collaborator makes even a small comment or critique, I can just snap. And it feels... it feels way bigger than the situation actually calls for. Like I get really irritable out of nowhere.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can’t hear?

Yeah, actually, I have. Um... when I'm alone in the studio working, I sometimes hear this woman's voice. She's usually quietly commenting on things from behind the storage shelves. And sometimes I'll also smell this really strong scent of hot metal near a piece I haven't finished yet. It all feels completely real in the moment, but then I'll stop and check around, and... there's no one there, and nothing is burning or heating up.
Have you ever heard that voice during a time when you were not feeling unusually energized or irritable?

Yeah, I have. There was actually a quieter month not too long ago where I wasn't feeling like that. I was sleeping more normally, and I didn't have that unstoppable energy or the irritability. But even then, for a few weeks, I still kept hearing that woman's voice making comments from behind the storage shelves. And I was still seeing those hidden warnings in ordinary studio materials, too, even though my mood felt pretty level.
Did these voice-hearing and hidden-warning experiences start suddenly over the course of a few days?

No, it wasn't sudden like that. It was more of a gradual thing. I didn't just wake up one day and suddenly hear her or see those warnings. It kind of built up slowly over a while until I realized it was happening pretty regularly.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

No, I haven't really had anything like that. I mean, I have days where I feel a little down or unmotivated, but not for two weeks straight, and definitely not most of the day. My mood hasn't really crashed like that.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least one week when you felt unusually energized or irritable most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. There are these stretches of time—definitely a week or longer—where I just feel kind of lit up. Like I'm almost unstoppable, and every idea I have in the studio is just brilliant. 

But then, I can get really irritable during those times, too. Like, a small comment from a collaborator can just make me snap, in a way that feels way bigger than the situation actually warrants. So, yeah, I definitely get both the energy and the irritability.
Have the voice-hearing and hidden-warning experiences lasted for at least one month in total?

Yeah, definitely longer than a month. I'd say... well, the messages I keep finding in my materials, and hearing that voice, or even noticing those strange smells when I'm in the studio... it's all been going on for roughly 11 months now.
During the times you felt unusually energized or irritable, did that mood last for most of the same period that the voice-hearing and hidden-warning experiences have been going on?

Yeah, I'd say so. Looking back over this whole time... the stretches where I'm energized, irritable, and just overproducing in the studio have definitely taken up more of the year than the calmer times. The intensity kind of rises and falls, but those high-energy moods have been around for the majority of the time all this other stuff has been happening.
